injuries.name: Colston Loveland
injuries.note: The knee injury that Loveland sustained during Thursday's 39-35 win over the Lions is expected to land him on IR, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Caleb Williams
injuries.note: Williams said after Thursday's 39-35 win in Detroit that he's "fine" and likely just has "a bruise on his abdomen," Jason Lieser of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.

injuries.name: Case Keenum
injuries.note: Keenum (coach's decision) is inactive and tabbed as the Bears' emergency third quarterback Thursday in Detroit.

injuries.name: Kyler Gordon
injuries.note: Gordon (shoulder) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Lions.

injuries.name: Roschon Johnson
injuries.note: Johnson (ankle) has been ruled out  for Thursday's game against the Lions.

injuries.name: DJ Wonnum
injuries.note: Wonnum (back) is inactive for Thursday's Week 12 battle against the Bears.

injuries.name: Chuck Clark
injuries.note: Clark (hamstring) is inactive for Thursday's clash against Chicago.

injuries.name: Skyler Gill-Howard
injuries.note: The Lions placed Gill-Howard (knee) on injured reserve Wednesday.
